_how_to_fill_this_in: Write, by hand, your three login endpoints exactly as they are in week05/api.md: the method, one space, the path. server/course_login.py, the course's login, answers on these paths.
email_field, code_field and token_field are the names of the fields in the requests and in the login answer (the token is a top-level key of the login answer).
Optional: email_must_end_with (such as ".edu.tr") if your REQ-001 accepts only some addresses; app_name is the name the e-mail with the code shows.
test_email_domain is the domain of the addresses the course tests use: it must pass email_must_end_with.
Replace every value in [square brackets]. The course tests in course_tests/ read this file.
request_code: [POST /path of the endpoint that sends the code]
login: [POST /path of the endpoint that logs in with the code]
me: [GET /path of the endpoint that answers with the logged-in user]
email_field: [the name of the e-mail field, such as email]
code_field: [the name of the code field, such as code]
token_field: [the name of the token field in the login answer, such as token]
app_name: [the name of your app, as the e-mail with the code shows it]
